_source.params.cbbPcb: 复用模块 PCB，`libraryUuid` 是 CBB 工程所在库的 UUID，`cbbUuid` 是 CBB 工程的 UUID，`uuid` 是 CBB 工程内 PCB 的 UUID

title: Place reuse block PCB
params.cbbPcb: Reuse block PCB. `libraryUuid` is the UUID of the library where the CBB project is located, `cbbUuid` is the UUID of the CBB project, and `uuid` is the UUID of the PCB in the CBB project
params.props: Placement parameters: `reimportWhenNameRepeated` - whether to re-import when a module with the same name exists, default `true`
returns: Place whether the operation is successful
